description: Send a test email for an existing campaign to preview how it will look in recipients' inboxes. Confirm the test address with the user first. Can be refused with 403 SENDING_PAUSED (workspace under review, nothing was sent, tell the user to contact support).

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

campaignId.description: Campaign ID to send test for

testEmail.description: Email address to send the test to

name: send_campaign_test
title: Send campaign test
